channel.title: CIS 450 - Computer Architecture and Operations :: CS Two Year Refactor
channel.description: Course Description Introduction to modern computer architectures: register transfer abstraction, addressing modes, basic operations (data transfer, arithmetic/logic, and control operations). Basic Operating System concepts and operations. Understanding relationships of higher-level language constructs to corresponding assembly instruction sequences generated by compilers. Introduction to interrupts and low-level I/O operations. Credit Hours 3 credits Course Goals and Learning Outcomes TBD Course Prerequisites Prerequisite: ECE 241 and CIS 308 (current catalog).
